description: From structured facts (which ДПС decision, when it was received, whether a complaint was filed) returns the dispute subject, which documents are possible now (complaint and/or lawsuit), the violations to choose from, and the deadlines with their legal basis. Start here for a user's tax dispute.

act.description: property_tax_ppr = tax notice-decision (ППР) on real estate tax (not land); foreign_income_ppr = tax notice-decision (ППР) on personal income tax and military levy for foreign income (CRS data, foreign accounts, transfers); esv_demand = demand (вимога) to pay the single social contribution (ЄСВ) debt — sole proprietor (ФОП), incl. mobilised; residency_certificate_refusal = refusal (or no answer) to issue a certificate of Ukrainian tax residence; overpayment_refund = refusal or failure to refund overpaid (erroneously paid) taxes; other = another decision (not supported yet).

appeal_decision_received_on.description: Date the decision on that complaint was received (YYYY-MM-DD).

appealed.description: A complaint to the ДПС of Ukraine was already filed.

as_of.description: Date to evaluate deadlines on. Default: today in Kyiv (YYYY-MM-DD).

channel.description: How it was received: e_cabinet, registered_mail, in_person, returned (letter returned to the ДПС, learned later).

jurisdiction.description: State whose procedure applies. Only "ua" (Ukraine) for now.

opponent.description: Who the dispute is with: dps (State Tax Service) or other (out of scope).

received_on.description: Date the decision (or the refusal) was received or the person learned of it (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: proc_qualify
title: Tax disputes: qualify the situation
